context_requirements: Expression of PTAFR on the assayed cell line
Presence of a PAFR-dependent transcriptional program in the cell type
Availability of downstream G-protein signaling components
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in PTAFR-dependent landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any line
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is reversed by PTAFR knockdown or a second PTAFR antagonist
Enrichment of inflammatory or NF-kB target genes specifically after PTAFR antagonist treatment
